title: IOMC Math Competition
text:
The IOMC Math Competition is a wide difficulty range test. It has 20 questions with 45 minutes to solve them. The problems range from Math Kangaroo to high AMC 12 problems. This will be held online and prevention of cheating will be integrity. Grades with more than 15 signups are eligible for a prize, which will be a gift card.

Signup on our [url=https://internationalonlin8.wixsite.com/competition]website[/url] and make sure to create an account. You can ask questions on the forum.
